items.label: Fashion Analog Watch
items.value: The ladies watch adopt simple and retro classic design, it's versatile and look good on any woman. Has the minimalist dial with 12-hour time mark, date, week and luminous hands, nice watch for daily wear.

items.label: Waterproof Watch
items.value: The elegant watch has stainless steel back cover, withstand washing hands, cold bath and splash. Please keep away hot water or steam.

items.label: Simple Watch & Light Weight
items.value: The simple design demonstrates enthusiasm and vitality. This is a design style that reflects modern trends and fashion. Light weight (24g) watch, no foreign body sensation in the hand, certainly comfortale for wear.

items.label: Durable & Accurate Time Keeping
items.value: This stap is made of tpu material, which is breathable wicking environmentally friendly. It can better protect the wrist and give you a softer and more comfortable wearing experience. Adopt advanced movement with analog display, provide precise time keeping.

items.label: Gift Watch & Warranty Service
items.value: A perfect gift for women, suit for any gift giving occasion: Valentine's Day, anniversary, business, birthday, Thanksgiving Day, mother's Day, Christmas etc. Offer 12-month warranty, if you have questions, contact us freely.
